params.body:
## Why

The first production run of `stocklist:photos-without-file` (after #557) found 165 `vehicle_photos` rows without a file; six of them were written after the cutover (15 to 17 September, one per vehicle, order 0, five dealers). Every writer of `vehicle_photos` was read for "can it leave a row without a file, and who writes order 0" (finding `2026-09-18-fotorijen-zonder-bestand-bij-upload.md`). The only writer whose leftover matches that signature (empty path, `processing = 0`, `sort_order = 0`) is the partner API before #557: `save()` with only `vehicle_id`, then the download threw. Five dealers means five dealers fed by Hexon, not five code paths.

The upload on the photo tab has a related hole: `upload_dropzone` writes its row with the tmp path and `processing = 1` before `ProcessVehiclePhoto` runs; when that job failed or the tmp file was gone, the row stayed spinning forever and was invisible to both `photos-without-file` (path not empty) and `clear-processing` (only resets the flag).

## What changed

- `ProcessVehiclePhoto`: a `failed()` that hard-deletes the row (and the tmp file) when the file never landed (`handled = 0`), with the reason in the log; the same when the tmp file is missing at the start. A redelivered job for a row that already has its file leaves it alone.
- `VehicleApiService::addPhoto`: one `create()` with the path in it instead of `save()` + `update()`.
- `OwnStockController::copyPhotos`: a row without `path` and `trans_path` is not copied to the new vehicle.
- `stocklist:photos-without-file --older-than=1d|12h|30m`: rows still being written are out of reach; `--apply` logs every removed row (id, vehicle, dealer, order, created).
- `routes/console.php`: weekly `stocklist:photos-without-file --older-than=1d --apply` (Monday 06:50, `withoutOverlapping`), pinned in `ScheduleTest`.
- Rule R S1-6.36 and the finding file.

Not changed: `_wagen_rij.blade.php` (hot file). `Vehicle::firstPhoto` already excludes `path = ''`, so an empty row never becomes the primary photo there; `filled()` is not needed.

## After the merge

`php artisan stocklist:photos-without-file --apply` on production removes the six rows (and the 159 legacy ones).

## Tests

`tests/Feature/PhotoRowOnlyWithFileTest.php` (7 tests: unreadable file, tmp gone, redelivered job, happy path, API one-statement insert, vehicle copy skips the empty row, sweep with age guard and log) and one `ScheduleTest` assertion. Run: `PhotoRowOnlyWithFileTest|ScheduleTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|RulesSourcesTest|ImportedPhotosWithoutFileTest|HeicUploadTest|PlatformPhotosOnShareTest|ProcessImageKeepsPhotoTest|PhotoProcessingProgressTest|CompiledViewsTest|SmokeTest`: OK (339 tests). `bin/rules-sources`: Geen problemen.
params.title: Photo rows only with a file: failed upload job removes its row, API writes in one statement, weekly sweep
